facts.fact: An EU press release carried by ANG says the birth registration services of the Candonga di Justiça caravan of 22-29 June 2026 would register children aged 0 to 7 using the SIREC digital registration system; this is a mobile caravan, not a fixed office.

ANG reports that the third Candonga di Justiça caravan, 22-29 June 2026, was to take birth registration on SIREC to 16 communities in Cacheu, Oio, Bafatá and Gabu; the document announces the plan and does not report the result.

systems.tiers: used by the mobile caravan in 16 communities of Cacheu, Oio, Bafatá and Gabu

systems.owner: UNDP and European Union, with the Centros de Acesso à Justiça
systems.tiers: third edition, 22-29 June 2026: 16 communities in Cacheu (São Domingos, Bigene), Oio (Farim), Bafatá and Gabu
